description: Activate Vault or Terobyte storage for the organization. Terobyte: pass sizeGb (5 c per GB, 10 GB steps, default 100 GB; limits in oma_storage_size_options). Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

serviceId.description: Service id of the website or service (from oma_read_services).

sizeGb.description: Terobyte size in GB (priced per GB); see oma_storage_size_options.

name: oma_storage_activate
title: Activate storage
